channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The US Department of Energy committed a $423 million loan to a Pattern Energy unit for new gas and battery storage capacity, a concrete boost to grid reliability that matters to site-selection decisions, while Amazon's new Dorado distribution center and Spanish bakery chain Levaduramadre's first location outside Spain add to the week's business-openings picture. On the risk side, the disputed 400MW Aguirre temporary generation contract is under investigation for an unauthorized Enchanted Rock signature and an undelivered $1.18 billion performance bond, with the Fiscal Oversight Board weighing revocation. Severe drought-driven water rationing, compounded by aging infrastructure losing 65% of produced water, underscores ongoing utility-reliability concerns relevant to investors.
